latest.title: Understanding AutoGrad in PyTorch and Its Role in WGAN
latest.description: Training neural networks feels simple until you ask: what actually happens behind loss.backward()? While implementing WGAN-GP, I explored PyTorch AutoGrad, computation graphs, requires_grad, torch.autograd.grad(), torch.ones_like(), and gradient flow in depth. Wrote a practical deep dive connecting AutoGrad to WGAN-GP.

latest.title: The MCP Supply Chain Attack: When Your Agent's Tools Are the Trojan Horse
latest.description: I tested three supply-chain attacks against my own MCP-connected agents. The model was never jailbroken — the tools did the damage. Here's how AgentCore Gateway, Cedar policies, and Bedrock Guardrails make unsafe actions architecturally impossible.

latest.title: Implementando Arquitetura Celular na AWS: Isolamento de Falhas com Route 53 e API Gateway
latest.description: Domine a construção de sistemas resilientes ao particionar cargas de trabalho em limites de contenção rigorosos, garantindo disponibilidade máxima para operações de missão crítica. Descubra como aplicar roteamento dinâmico, validação de borda e padrões hexagonais para evitar falhas em cascata em ambientes de produção.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description:
ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is a scientific claim verification engine built  for the AI era — where information can be generated instantly, but trust cannot, to address the growing problem of hallucinated citations and  AI-generated information.

Instead of probabilistic prediction, ASET retrieves, analyzes, and synthesizes evidence from 1.2M+ indexed research papers to produce literature-backed verification reports for claims extracted from text, documents, webpages, images, and videos.
